# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
import math
# endregion


class ParallelTwoSlotTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    One template, two slots, no gate. Both slots run independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy when close crosses above its SMA (invest 40% of TPV),
                                 sell when close crosses below its SMA (liquidate the lot).
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy after 3 consecutive red days ($20,000 if that much cash
                                  is available, otherwise do nothing),
                                  sell when the 14-day RSI closes above 60 (liquidate the lot).
    """

    # ----- fixed setup -----
    UNIVERSE = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    # ----- strategy parameters -----
    SMA_PERIOD = 20               # Strategy A: "its simple moving average"
    A_ALLOCATION = 0.40           # invest 40% of total portfolio value
    RED_DAYS = 3                  # Strategy B: red for 3 consecutive days
    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0         # level condition ("closes above 60"), not a cross
    B_ORDER_CASH = 20000.0        # buy $20,000 if at least $20,000 cash is available
    WARMUP_BARS = 60              # enough for SMA(20)+1 and RSI(14)+1 to be fully formed

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.UNIVERSE:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY)
            equity.set_data_normalization_mode(DataNormalizationMode.ADJUSTED)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # Indicators are updated manually from every bar that arrives, so market-state
        # quantities are computed continuously and never depend on rule evaluation.
        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage("SPY_SMA_%d" % self.SMA_PERIOD, self.SMA_PERIOD)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex("AAPL_RSI_%d" % self.RSI_PERIOD,
                                              self.RSI_PERIOD,
                                              MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        # continuous market state
        self.spy_prev_close = None
        self.spy_prev_sma = None
        self.spy_bars = 0
        self.aapl_prev_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_bars = 0

        # private lots (shares owned by each strategy)
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

        self.set_warm_up(self.WARMUP_BARS)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    def _bar(self, data, symbol):
        """Today's trade bar for a symbol, or None when it is missing."""
        if data is None or data.bars is None:
            return None
        if symbol not in data.bars:
            return None
        bar = data.bars[symbol]
        if bar is None or bar.close <= 0:
            return None
        return bar

    def _submit(self, symbol, quantity, tag):
        """Place a market order; returns True when the order was accepted."""
        if quantity == 0:
            return False
        ticket = self.market_order(symbol, quantity, tag=tag)
        return ticket is not None and ticket.status != OrderStatus.INVALID

    def _rules_ready(self):
        """Every indicator / rolling window used by a rule is fully formed."""
        return (self.spy_sma.is_ready
                and self.spy_bars > self.SMA_PERIOD          # yesterday's SMA also formed
                and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
                and self.aapl_bars > self.RED_DAYS)          # a true 3-day streak is measurable

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ data handler

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = self._bar(data, self.spy)
        aapl_bar = self._bar(data, self.aapl)

        # ---------- continuous state updates (never gated by rule evaluation) ----------
        spy_cross_up = False
        spy_cross_down = False
        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma.update(spy_bar.end_time, spy_bar.close)
            sma_now = self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None

            if self.spy_prev_close is not None and self.spy_prev_sma is not None and sma_now is not None:
                # cross above: yesterday close <= yesterday SMA and today close > today SMA
                spy_cross_up = (self.spy_prev_close <= self.spy_prev_sma) and (spy_bar.close > sma_now)
                # cross below: yesterday close >= yesterday SMA and today close < today SMA
                spy_cross_down = (self.spy_prev_close >= self.spy_prev_sma) and (spy_bar.close < sma_now)

            self.spy_prev_close = spy_bar.close
            self.spy_prev_sma = sma_now
            self.spy_bars += 1

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_bar.close)
            if self.aapl_prev_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.close < self.aapl_prev_close:      # strictly below => red day
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_prev_close = aapl_bar.close
            self.aapl_bars += 1

        if self.is_warming_up:
            return

        # ---------- skip the whole day when any subscribed ticker has no bar ----------
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if self._bar(data, symbol) is None:
                return

        if not self._rules_ready():
            return

        # ---------- sells before buys ----------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A sell: SPY close crosses below its SMA -> liquidate the lot
        if self.lot_a > 0 and spy_cross_down:
            if self._submit(self.spy, -self.lot_a, "A: SELL SPY cross below SMA"):
                self.lot_a = 0

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B sell: AAPL 14-day RSI closes above 60 -> liquidate the lot
        if self.lot_b > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            if self._submit(self.aapl, -self.lot_b, "B: SELL AAPL RSI>60"):
                self.lot_b = 0

        # ---------- buys ----------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A buy: SPY close crosses above its SMA -> 40% of total portfolio value
        if self.lot_a == 0 and spy_cross_up:
            target_value = self.A_ALLOCATION * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_bar.close))
            if quantity > 0 and self._submit(self.spy, quantity, "A: BUY SPY cross above SMA"):
                self.lot_a = quantity

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B buy: AAPL red 3 consecutive days -> $20,000 if that cash is available
        if self.lot_b == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= self.RED_DAYS:
            if self.portfolio.cash >= self.B_ORDER_CASH:
                quantity = int(math.floor(self.B_ORDER_CASH / aapl_bar.close))
                if quantity > 0 and self._submit(self.aapl, quantity, "B: BUY AAPL 3 red days"):
                    self.lot_b = quantity
            # otherwise: do nothing this bar, the reason may fire again later

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ safety net

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
        if order_event.status not in (OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID):
            return
        # An order that never reached the market must not leave phantom shares in a lot.
        order = self.transactions.get_order_by_id(order_event.order_id)
        if order is None:
            return
        if order.symbol == self.spy:
            self.lot_a = max(0, int(self.portfolio[self.spy].quantity))
        elif order.symbol == self.aapl:
            self.lot_b = max(0, int(self.portfolio[self.aapl].quantity))

# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
import math
# endregion


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fixed strategy parameters
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SMA_PERIOD = 20             # Strategy A: period of SPY's simple moving average
RSI_PERIOD = 14             # Strategy B: 14-day RSI on AAPL
RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0       # Strategy B: RSI level whose breach closes the lot
RED_STREAK_DAYS = 3         # Strategy B: consecutive red days required to buy
A_ALLOCATION = 0.40         # Strategy A: 40% of total portfolio value per buy
B_CASH_PER_BUY = 20000.0    # Strategy B: dollars deployed per buy

TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]


class Lot:
    """
    A strategy's private inventory.

    A strategy may only ever sell shares it bought itself, its buy reason is
    evaluated only while the lot is empty, and its sell reason only while the
    lot is non-empty.  In-flight (pending) quantity counts as "non-empty" so a
    reason cannot fire twice for the same round trip.
    """

    def __init__(self, strategy_id, symbol):
        self.strategy_id = strategy_id
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.shares = 0      # filled shares currently owned by this lot
        self.pending = 0     # signed quantity of this lot's un-filled orders

    @property
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.shares == 0 and self.pending == 0

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return not self.is_empty


class ParallelTwoSlotAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    One template, two slots, no gate -- both slots run independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 / Strategy A (SPY)
        buy  : SPY close crosses above its SMA        -> invest 40% of TPV
        sell : SPY close crosses below its SMA        -> liquidate A's lot

      Slot 2 / Strategy B (AAPL)
        buy  : AAPL red for 3 consecutive days        -> $20,000 if cash allows
        sell : AAPL 14-day RSI closes above 60        -> liquidate B's lot

    All rules are evaluated once per daily bar, after the close.  If today's bar
    is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, no rule is evaluated that day, but
    market-state quantities (streaks, indicators) keep being computed from data.
    """

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ setup
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in TICKERS:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # Indicators (updated continuously by the data feed, never gated).
        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.WILDERS,
                                 Resolution.DAILY)

        # Continuously maintained market state.
        self.prev_close = {}    # symbol -> previous observed daily close
        self.red_streak = {}    # symbol -> consecutive red days completed today
        self.prev_spy_close = None   # SPY close as of the previous observed bar
        self.prev_spy_sma = None     # SPY SMA value as of that same bar

        # Private lots, one per slot.
        self.lots = {
            "A": Lot("A", self.spy),
            "B": Lot("B", self.aapl),
        }
        self.order_remaining = {}   # order id -> quantity still working

        # Do not trade until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed.
        self.set_warm_up(max(SMA_PERIOD, RSI_PERIOD * 4) + 5, Resolution.DAILY)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- daily loop
    def on_data(self, slice):
        # "Yesterday" values, captured before anything is refreshed today.
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma

        # Collect today's usable bars.
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if symbol in slice.bars:
                bar = slice.bars[symbol]
                if bar is not None and bar.close > 0:
                    bars[symbol] = bar

        # --- market state is always computed from data, whatever the rules do ---
        for symbol, bar in bars.items():
            last = self.prev_close.get(symbol)
            if last is not None:
                if bar.close < last:                     # strictly below -> red
                    self.red_streak[symbol] = self.red_streak.get(symbol, 0) + 1
                else:
                    self.red_streak[symbol] = 0
            self.prev_close[symbol] = bar.close

        can_evaluate = (
            not self.is_warming_up
            and len(bars) == len(self.symbols)           # no ticker missing today
            and self.spy_sma.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and prev_spy_close is not None
            and prev_spy_sma is not None
            and self.aapl in self.red_streak
        )

        if can_evaluate:
            self._evaluate(bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma)

        # Roll SPY's cross state forward for tomorrow's comparison.
        if self.spy in bars:
            self.prev_spy_close = bars[self.spy].close
            self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ rules
    def _evaluate(self, bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma):
        spy_close = bars[self.spy].close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
        aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].close
        aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.current.value

        lot_a = self.lots["A"]
        lot_b = self.lots["B"]

        # ---------------------------- sells are evaluated before buys --------
        # Strategy A sell: SPY close crosses BELOW its SMA.
        if lot_a.is_open and prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma and spy_close < spy_sma:
            self._exit(lot_a, "SPY close crossed below SMA({0})".format(SMA_PERIOD))

        # Strategy B sell: AAPL's 14-day RSI closes above 60 (level, not a cross).
        if lot_b.is_open and aapl_rsi > RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._exit(lot_b, "AAPL RSI({0})={1:.2f} > {2:.0f}".format(
                RSI_PERIOD, aapl_rsi, RSI_SELL_LEVEL))

        # ---------------------------------------------- buys -----------------
        # Strategy A buy: SPY close crosses ABOVE its SMA -> 40% of portfolio.
        if lot_a.is_empty and prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma and spy_close > spy_sma:
            target_value = A_ALLOCATION * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self._enter(lot_a, quantity,
                            "SPY close crossed above SMA({0})".format(SMA_PERIOD))

        # Strategy B buy: AAPL red 3+ consecutive days -> $20,000 if available.
        if lot_b.is_empty and self.red_streak.get(self.aapl, 0) >= RED_STREAK_DAYS:
            available_cash = self.portfolio.cash
            if available_cash >= B_CASH_PER_BUY:
                quantity = int(math.floor(B_CASH_PER_BUY / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self._enter(lot_b, quantity,
                                "AAPL red {0} consecutive days".format(
                                    self.red_streak[self.aapl]))
            # otherwise: do nothing this bar, the reason may fire again later.

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ order plumbing
    def _enter(self, lot, quantity, reason):
        lot.pending += quantity
        ticket = self.market_order(lot.symbol, quantity,
                                   tag="{0}|BUY|{1}".format(lot.strategy_id, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            lot.pending -= quantity

    def _exit(self, lot, reason):
        quantity = lot.shares
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        lot.pending -= quantity
        ticket = self.market_order(lot.symbol, -quantity,
                                   tag="{0}|SELL|{1}".format(lot.strategy_id, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            lot.pending += quantity

    def on_order_event(self, order_event):
        order = self.transactions.get_order_by_id(order_event.order_id)
        if order is None or not order.tag:
            return

        lot = self.lots.get(order.tag.split("|")[0])
        if lot is None:
            return

        order_id = order_event.order_id
        if order_id not in self.order_remaining:
            self.order_remaining[order_id] = int(order.quantity)

        fill_quantity = int(order_event.fill_quantity)
        if fill_quantity != 0:
            lot.shares += fill_quantity
            lot.pending -= fill_quantity
            self.order_remaining[order_id] -= fill_quantity

        if order_event.status in (OrderStatus.FILLED,
                                  OrderStatus.CANCELED,
                                  OrderStatus.INVALID):
            leftover = self.order_remaining.pop(order_id, 0)
            lot.pending -= leftover      # release any quantity that never filled
            if lot.shares < 0:
                lot.shares = 0

        self.prev_close = {}    # symbol -> previous observed daily close
        self.red_streak = {}    # symbol -> consecutive red days completed today
        self.prev_spy_close = None   # SPY close as of the previous observed bar
        self.prev_spy_sma = None     # SPY SMA value as of that same bar

        # Private lots, one per slot.
        self.lots = {
            "A": Lot("A", self.spy),
            "B": Lot("B", self.aapl),

        self.order_remaining = {}   # order id -> quantity still working

                if bar is not None and bar.close > 0:

                    self.red_streak[symbol] = self.red_streak.get(symbol, 0) + 1

            not self.is_warming_up
            and len(bars) == len(self.symbols)           # no ticker missing today
            and self.spy_sma.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and prev_spy_close is not None
            and prev_spy_sma is not None
            and self.aapl in self.red_streak
        )

        if can_evaluate:
            self._evaluate(bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma)

        if self.spy in bars:
            self.prev_spy_close = bars[self.spy].close
            self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None

        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
        aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].close
        aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.current.value

        lot_a = self.lots["A"]
        lot_b = self.lots["B"]

        # ---------------------------- sells are evaluated before buys --------
        # Strategy A sell: SPY close crosses BELOW its SMA.
        if lot_a.is_open and prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma and spy_close < spy_sma:
            self._exit(lot_a, "SPY close crossed below SMA({0})".format(SMA_PERIOD))

        # Strategy B sell: AAPL's 14-day RSI closes above 60 (level, not a cross).
        if lot_b.is_open and aapl_rsi > RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._exit(lot_b, "AAPL RSI({0})={1:.2f} > {2:.0f}".format(
                RSI_PERIOD, aapl_rsi, RSI_SELL_LEVEL))

        # ---------------------------------------------- buys -----------------
        # Strategy A buy: SPY close crosses ABOVE its SMA -> 40% of portfolio.
        if lot_a.is_empty and prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma and spy_close > spy_sma:
            target_value = A_ALLOCATION * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self._enter(lot_a, quantity,
                            "SPY close crossed above SMA({0})".format(SMA_PERIOD))

        # Strategy B buy: AAPL red 3+ consecutive days -> $20,000 if available.
        if lot_b.is_empty and self.red_streak.get(self.aapl, 0) >= RED_STREAK_DAYS:
            available_cash = self.portfolio.cash
            if available_cash >= B_CASH_PER_BUY:
                quantity = int(math.floor(B_CASH_PER_BUY / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self._enter(lot_b, quantity,
                                "AAPL red {0} consecutive days".format(
                                    self.red_streak[self.aapl]))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ order plumbing
    def _enter(self, lot, quantity, reason):
        lot.pending += quantity
        ticket = self.market_order(lot.symbol, quantity,
                                   tag="{0}|BUY|{1}".format(lot.strategy_id, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            lot.pending -= quantity

    def _exit(self, lot, reason):
        quantity = lot.shares
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        lot.pending -= quantity
        ticket = self.market_order(lot.symbol, -quantity,
                                   tag="{0}|SELL|{1}".format(lot.strategy_id, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            lot.pending += quantity

    def on_order_event(self, order_event):
        order = self.transactions.get_order_by_id(order_event.order_id)
        if order is None or not order.tag:
            return

        lot = self.lots.get(order.tag.split("|")[0])
        if lot is None:
            return

        order_id = order_event.order_id
        if order_id not in self.order_remaining:
            self.order_remaining[order_id] = int(order.quantity)

        fill_quantity = int(order_event.fill_quantity)
        if fill_quantity != 0:
            lot.shares += fill_quantity
            lot.pending -= fill_quantity
            self.order_remaining[order_id] -= fill_quantity

        if order_event.status in (OrderStatus.FILLED,
                                  OrderStatus.CANCELED,
                                  OrderStatus.INVALID):
            leftover = self.order_remaining.pop(order_id, 0)
            lot.pending -= leftover      # release any quantity that never filled
            if lot.shares < 0:

            return
        self._submit(lot, -lot.shares, tag)

        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            self.pending.pop(orderEvent.OrderId, None)
            return

        if orderEvent.Status != OrderStatus.Canceled and orderEvent.Status != OrderStatus.Invalid:
            return

        record = self.pending.pop(orderEvent.OrderId, None)
        if record is None:
            return

        # Undo the optimistic accounting for whatever never filled.
        lot, submitted = record
        ticket = self.Transactions.GetOrderTicket(orderEvent.OrderId)
        filled = int(ticket.QuantityFilled) if ticket is not None else 0
        lot.shares -= (submitted - filled)
        if lot.shares < 0:
            lot.shares = 0

class StrategyLot:
    """Private inventory owned by a single strategy slot.

    A strategy sells only shares it bought: its buy reason is evaluated only
    while `shares == 0`, its sell reason only while `shares > 0`.  `pending`
    blocks re-evaluation while an order for this lot is still working.
    """

    def __init__(self, name, symbol):
        self.name = name
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.shares = 0
        self.pending = False

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0


class TwoSlotParallelTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """One template, two slots, no gate.  Both slots run in parallel."""

    # ---- strategy parameters ------------------------------------------------
    SMA_PERIOD = 20          # length of SPY's simple moving average
    A_ALLOCATION = 0.40      # Strategy A invests 40% of total portfolio value
    RSI_PERIOD = 14          # AAPL's 14-day RSI
    RSI_EXIT_LEVEL = 60.0    # Strategy B exits when RSI closes above this level
    B_RED_DAYS = 3           # AAPL red for 3 consecutive days
    B_CASH_OUTLAY = 20000.0  # Strategy B buys $20,000 if that much cash is free

    # =========================================================================
    # Setup
    # =========================================================================
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = [self.AddEquity(t, Resolution.Daily).Symbol for t in self.tickers]
        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        # Small liquidating orders must never be dropped.
        self.Settings.MinimumOrderMarginPortfolioPercentage = 0

        # Indicators are updated by hand inside OnData so that "today's value"
        # and "yesterday's value" are unambiguous when testing for crosses.
        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        # Continuously maintained market state.  These are always advanced from
        # data, whatever the strategies are or are not allowed to do.
        self.spy_close_today = None
        self.spy_close_prev = None
        self.spy_sma_today = None
        self.spy_sma_prev = None
        self.aapl_close_today = None
        self.aapl_rsi_today = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # Slot 1 -> Strategy A (SPY), Slot 2 -> Strategy B (AAPL).
        self.lot_a = StrategyLot("A", self.spy)
        self.lot_b = StrategyLot("B", self.aapl)
        self.lots = {"A": self.lot_a, "B": self.lot_b}

        self.order_owner = {}  # order id -> lot name

    # =========================================================================
    # Daily bar handling
    # =========================================================================
    def OnData(self, data):
        # Market state advances first, from whatever bars arrived.
        self._update_market_state(data)

        # If today's bar is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, skip all rules.
        if not self._all_bars_present(data):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys; slot 1 before slot 2.
        self._sell_slot_1()
        self._sell_slot_2()
        self._buy_slot_1()
        self._buy_slot_2()

    def _all_bars_present(self, data):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return False
            if data.Bars[symbol] is None:
                return False
        return True

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) and bars[self.spy] is not None:
            bar = bars[self.spy]
            # Yesterday's readings are today's readings from the previous bar.
            self.spy_close_prev = self.spy_close_today
            self.spy_sma_prev = self.spy_sma_today

            self.spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
            self.spy_close_today = float(bar.Close)
            self.spy_sma_today = (float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
                                  if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None)

        if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) and bars[self.aapl] is not None:
            bar = bars[self.aapl]
            close = float(bar.Close)

            # A red day is a close strictly below the previous close; anything
            # else (green or unchanged) breaks the streak.
            if self.aapl_close_today is not None:
                if close < self.aapl_close_today:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
            self.aapl_close_today = close
            self.aapl_rsi_today = (float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)
                                   if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady else None)

    # =========================================================================
    # Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY, close vs. its simple moving average)
    # =========================================================================
    def _a_formed(self):
        return (self.spy_close_prev is not None and self.spy_sma_prev is not None
                and self.spy_close_today is not None and self.spy_sma_today is not None)

    def _sell_slot_1(self):
        lot = self.lot_a
        if lot.pending or not lot.is_open or not self._a_formed():
            return
        if self._crossed_below(self.spy_close_prev, self.spy_sma_prev,
                               self.spy_close_today, self.spy_sma_today):
            self._submit(lot, -lot.shares)  # liquidate Strategy A's entire lot

    def _buy_slot_1(self):
        lot = self.lot_a

class StrategyLot:
    """Private inventory owned by a single strategy slot.

    A strategy sells only shares it bought: its buy reason is evaluated only

    """

        self.name = name
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.shares = 0
        self.pending = False

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0

    RSI_EXIT_LEVEL = 60.0    # Strategy B exits when RSI closes above this level
    B_RED_DAYS = 3           # AAPL red for 3 consecutive days
    B_CASH_OUTLAY = 20000.0  # Strategy B buys $20,000 if that much cash is free

    # Setup
    # =========================================================================

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        self.symbols = [self.AddEquity(t, Resolution.Daily).Symbol for t in self.tickers]
        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        # Small liquidating orders must never be dropped.
        self.Settings.MinimumOrderMarginPortfolioPercentage = 0

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)

        # data, whatever the strategies are or are not allowed to do.
        self.spy_close_today = None
        self.spy_close_prev = None
        self.spy_sma_today = None
        self.spy_sma_prev = None
        self.aapl_close_today = None
        self.aapl_rsi_today = None

class TwoSlotParallelTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

            SIZE : invest 40% of total portfolio value

            SELL : AAPL 14-day RSI closes above 60
            EXIT : liquidate Strategy B's entire lot

    Both slots run in parallel; each owns a private lot and only ever sells shares

    only on days where every subscribed ticker printed a bar.
    """

    # ---- strategy parameters -------------------------------------------------
    SMA_PERIOD = 20              # period of Strategy A's simple moving average
    ALLOCATION_A = 0.40          # 40% of total portfolio value
    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0
    RED_DAYS_REQUIRED = 3
    CASH_PER_TRADE_B = 20000.0

    TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    # Initialization
    # =========================================================================
    def Initialize(self):

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
            equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Adjusted)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
        self.SetBenchmark(self.spy)

        # Indicators are updated manually, exactly once per bar, so that the
        # "today's value" used by the rules is deterministic.
        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        # ---- market state (computed continuously from data) ------------------
        self.prev_close = {}            # ticker -> previous bar's close
        self.prev_spy_sma = None        # SMA value as of the previous SPY bar
        self.prev_spy_sma_ready = False
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0        # consecutive red days for AAPL
        self.aapl_bar_count = 0

        # ---- private lots (shares owned by each strategy) --------------------
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

        # orderId -> {"strategy", "intended", "filled"} for lot reconciliation
        self.pending_orders = {}

        self.verbose = False

    # =========================================================================
    # Daily bar handler
    # =========================================================================
    def OnData(self, data):
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 0. Collect today's bars (a ticker with no bar today simply has no bar)
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                bar = data.Bars[symbol]
                if bar is not None and bar.Close > 0:
                    bars[ticker] = bar

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_close.get("SPY")
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma
        prev_spy_sma_ready = self.prev_spy_sma_ready

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. Update market-state quantities from data (always, never gated)
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        if "SPY" in bars:
            spy_bar = bars["SPY"]
            self.spy_sma.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(self.spy, spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close))

        if "AAPL" in bars:
            aapl_bar = bars["AAPL"]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(self.aapl, aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close))
            self.aapl_bar_count += 1
            prev_aapl_close = self.prev_close.get("AAPL")
            if prev_aapl_close is not None:
                # red day = close strictly below the previous close
                if aapl_bar.Close < prev_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Rule evaluation - only on a day where EVERY ticker printed a bar
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        if len(bars) == len(self.symbols) and self._history_ready():
            self._evaluate_rules(bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma, prev_spy_sma_ready)

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 4. Roll state forward for the next bar
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        for ticker, bar in bars.items():
            self.prev_close[ticker] = bar.Close
        if "SPY" in bars:
            self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            self.prev_spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady

    # =========================================================================
    # Rules
    # =========================================================================
    def _history_ready(self):
        """No trading until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed."""
        return (self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.prev_spy_sma is not None
                and self.prev_spy_sma_ready
                and self.prev_close.get("SPY") is not None
                and self.aapl_bar_count > self.RED_DAYS_REQUIRED)

    def _evaluate_rules(self, bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma, prev_spy_sma_ready):
        spy_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        cross_above = (prev_spy_sma_ready
                       and prev_spy_close is not None
                       and prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma
                       and spy_close > spy_sma)
        cross_below = (prev_spy_sma_ready
                       and prev_spy_close is not None
                       and prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma
                       and spy_close < spy_sma)

        # ---------------- sells are always evaluated before buys --------------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A: sell on close crossing below the SMA
        if self.lot_a > 0 and cross_above is not None and cross_below:
            self._submit("A", self.spy, -self.lot_a, "SPY closed below its SMA (cross)")

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B: sell on RSI(14) above 60
        if self.lot_b > 0 and rsi > self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._submit("B", self.aapl, -self.lot_b, "AAPL RSI(14) closed above 60")

        # ---------------- buys (only while the strategy's lot is empty) -------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A: buy on close crossing above the SMA, 40% of TPV
        if self.lot_a == 0 and cross_above:
            target_value = self.ALLOCATION_A * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self._submit("A", self.spy, quantity, "SPY closed above its SMA (cross)")

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B: buy $20,000 of AAPL after 3 consecutive red days
        if self.lot_b == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= self.RED_DAYS_REQUIRED:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook[self.AccountCurrency].Amount
            if available_cash >= self.CASH_PER_TRADE_B:
                quantity = int(math.floor(self.CASH_PER_TRADE_B / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self._submit("B", self.aapl, quantity,
                                 "AAPL red for {0} consecutive days".format(self.aapl_red_streak))
            # otherwise: do nothing this bar, the reason may fire again later

    # =========================================================================
    # Order plumbing / lot bookkeeping
    # =========================================================================
    def _submit(self, strategy, symbol, quantity, reason):
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, tag="{0}: {1}".format(strategy, reason))
        if ticket is None:
            return

        status = ticket.Status
        if status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
            return

        # optimistically move the lot, then reconcile against actual fills
        self._adjust_lot(strategy, quantity)
        self.pending_orders[ticket.OrderId] = {
            "strategy": strategy,
            "intended": quantity,
            "filled": 0,
        }

        if self.verbose:
            self.Debug("{0} | {1} {2} {3} | {4}".format(
                self.Time.date(), strategy, quantity, symbol.Value, reason))

    def _adjust_lot(self, strategy, delta):
        if strategy == "A":
            self.lot_a = max(0, self.lot_a + delta)
        elif strategy == "B":
            self.lot_b = max(0, self.lot_b + delta)

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        info = self.pending_orders.get(orderEvent.OrderId)
        if info is None:
            return

        if orderEvent.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled):
            info["filled"] += orderEvent.FillQuantity

        if orderEvent.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled,
                                 OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                 OrderStatus.Invalid):
            # lot already moved by "intended"; correct it to what really filled
            self._adjust_lot(info["strategy"], info["filled"] - info["intended"])
            del self.pending_orders[orderEvent.OrderId]

    # =========================================================================
    def _history_ready(self):
        """No trading until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed."""
        return (self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.prev_spy_sma is not None
                and self.prev_spy_sma_ready
                and self.prev_close.get("SPY") is not None
                and self.aapl_bar_count > self.RED_DAYS_REQUIRED)

    def _evaluate_rules(self, bars, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_sma, prev_spy_sma_ready):
        spy_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        cross_above = (prev_spy_sma_ready
                       and prev_spy_close is not None
                       and prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma
                       and spy_close > spy_sma)
        cross_below = (prev_spy_sma_ready
                       and prev_spy_close is not None
                       and prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma
                       and spy_close < spy_sma)

        # ---------------- sells are always evaluated before buys --------------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A: sell on close crossing below the SMA
        if self.lot_a > 0 and cross_above is not None and cross_below:
            self._submit("A", self.spy, -self.lot_a, "SPY closed below its SMA (cross)")

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B: sell on RSI(14) above 60
        if self.lot_b > 0 and rsi > self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._submit("B", self.aapl, -self.lot_b, "AAPL RSI(14) closed above 60")

        # ---------------- buys (only while the strategy's lot is empty) -------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A: buy on close crossing above the SMA, 40% of TPV
        if self.lot_a == 0 and cross_above:
            target_value = self.ALLOCATION_A * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self._submit("A", self.spy, quantity, "SPY closed above its SMA (cross)")

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B: buy $20,000 of AAPL after 3 consecutive red days
        if self.lot_b == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= self.RED_DAYS_REQUIRED:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook[self.AccountCurrency].Amount
            if available_cash >= self.CASH_PER_TRADE_B:
                quantity = int(math.floor(self.CASH_PER_TRADE_B / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self._submit("B", self.aapl, quantity,
                                 "AAPL red for {0} consecutive days".format(self.aapl_red_streak))
            # otherwise: do nothing this bar, the reason may fire again later

    # =========================================================================
    # Order plumbing / lot bookkeeping
    # =========================================================================
    def _submit(self, strategy, symbol, quantity, reason):
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, tag="{0}: {1}".format(strategy, reason))
        if ticket is None:
            return

        status = ticket.Status
        if status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
            return

        # optimistically move the lot, then reconcile against actual fills
        self._adjust_lot(strategy, quantity)
        self.pending_orders[ticket.OrderId] = {
            "strategy": strategy,
            "intended": quantity,
            "filled": 0,
        }

        if self.verbose:
            self.Debug("{0} | {1} {2} {3} | {4}".format(
                self.Time.date(), strategy, quantity, symbol.Value, reason))

    def _adjust_lot(self, strategy, delta):
        if strategy == "A":
            self.lot_a = max(0, self.lot_a + delta)
        elif strategy == "B":
            self.lot_b = max(0, self.lot_b + delta)

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        info = self.pending_orders.get(orderEvent.OrderId)
        if info is None:
            return

        if orderEvent.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled):
            info["filled"] += orderEvent.FillQuantity

        if orderEvent.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled,
                                 OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                 OrderStatus.Invalid):
            # lot already moved by "intended"; correct it to what really filled
            self._adjust_lot(info["strategy"], info["filled"] - info["intended"])
            del self.pending_orders[orderEvent.OrderId]

# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
import math
# endregion


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Strategy parameters
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
SPY_SMA_PERIOD = 20                 # "simple moving average" used by Strategy A
AAPL_RSI_PERIOD = 14                # "14-day RSI" used by Strategy B
AAPL_RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0
STRATEGY_A_WEIGHT = 0.40            # invest 40% of total portfolio value
STRATEGY_B_CASH = 20000.0           # buy $20,000 if that much cash is available
STRATEGY_B_RED_DAYS = 3             # red for 3 consecutive days
WARM_UP_BARS = 60                   # enough history for every rule to be formed


class Lot:
    """
    A private lot of shares owned by exactly one strategy.  A strategy can only
    ever sell shares that its own lot bought, so two strategies trading the same
    ticker can never touch each other's position.

    Fills are assumed optimistically when an order is submitted (so a reason
    cannot fire twice while an order is in flight) and reconciled against the
    real fill once the order reaches a terminal state.
    """

    def __init__(self, algorithm, symbol, name):
        self._algorithm = algorithm
        self._symbol = symbol
        self._name = name
        self._tickets = []
        self.shares = 0

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0

    def reconcile(self):
        """Replace the assumed fill of every finished order with the real one."""
        pending = []
        for ticket, assumed in self._tickets:
            if ticket.status in (OrderStatus.FILLED, OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID):
                self.shares += int(ticket.quantity_filled) - assumed
            else:
                pending.append((ticket, assumed))
        self._tickets = pending
        if self.shares < 0:
            self.shares = 0

    def buy(self, quantity, reason):
        quantity = int(quantity)
        if quantity > 0:
            self._submit(quantity, reason)

    def liquidate(self, reason):
        if self.shares > 0:
            self._submit(-self.shares, reason)

    def _submit(self, quantity, reason):
        ticket = self._algorithm.market_order(
            self._symbol, quantity, tag="{0}: {1}".format(self._name, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            return
        self.shares += quantity
        self._tickets.append((ticket, quantity))


class ParallelDualStrategyTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    One template, two slots, no gate.  Both slots run independently in parallel:

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy on close crossing above its SMA (40% of
               total portfolio value), sell on close crossing below its SMA.
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy $20,000 after 3 consecutive red days if
               at least $20,000 cash is available, sell when the 14-day RSI
               closes above 60.
    """

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1000000)

        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self._symbols = [self.add_equity(t, Resolution.DAILY).symbol for t in tickers]
        self._spy = self._symbols[0]
        self._aapl = self._symbols[1]

        # Indicators are updated by hand inside on_data so that every rule is
        # evaluated against the values of the very bar being processed.
        self._sma = SimpleMovingAverage(SPY_SMA_PERIOD)
        self._rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(AAPL_RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        # Market state.  These are maintained continuously from the data and are
        # never paused by trading logic.
        self._prev_close = {}
        self._red_streak = {symbol: 0 for symbol in self._symbols}
        self._bar_count = {symbol: 0 for symbol in self._symbols}
        self._spy_prev_sma = None

        # The template's two slots, each with its own private lot.
        self._lot_a = Lot(self, self._spy, "Strategy A")
        self._lot_b = Lot(self, self._aapl, "Strategy B")

        self.set_warm_up(WARM_UP_BARS, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, data):
        self._lot_a.reconcile()
        self._lot_b.reconcile()

        # Collect today's bars for every subscribed ticker.
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self._symbols:
            if data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                bar = data.bars[symbol]
                if bar is not None and bar.close > 0:
                    bars[symbol] = bar

        # Market state is always advanced with whatever data did arrive.
        signals = self._update_market_state(bars)

        # If today's bar is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, no rule is
        # evaluated on this bar.
        if len(bars) < len(self._symbols):
            return

        if self.is_warming_up or not self._is_ready():
            return

        spy_cross_up = signals.get("spy_cross_up", False)
        spy_cross_down = signals.get("spy_cross_down", False)
        aapl_rsi = signals.get("aapl_rsi")

        # ---- sells first, in slot order ------------------------------------
        if self._lot_a.is_open and spy_cross_down:
            self._lot_a.liquidate("close crossed below SMA({0})".format(SPY_SMA_PERIOD))

        if self._lot_b.is_open and aapl_rsi is not None and aapl_rsi > AAPL_RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._lot_b.liquidate("RSI({0}) closed above {1:.0f}".format(
                AAPL_RSI_PERIOD, AAPL_RSI_SELL_LEVEL))

        # ---- then buys, in slot order --------------------------------------
        if not self._lot_a.is_open and spy_cross_up:
            target_value = STRATEGY_A_WEIGHT * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / bars[self._spy].close))

class Lot:
    """
    A private lot of shares owned by exactly one strategy.  A strategy can only
    ever sell shares that its own lot bought, so two strategies trading the same
    ticker can never touch each other's position.

    Fills are assumed optimistically when an order is submitted (so a reason
    cannot fire twice while an order is in flight) and reconciled against the
    real fill once the order reaches a terminal state.
    """

    def __init__(self, algorithm, symbol, name):
        self._algorithm = algorithm
        self._symbol = symbol
        self._name = name
        self._tickets = []
        self.shares = 0

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0

    def reconcile(self):
        """Replace the assumed fill of every finished order with the real one."""
        pending = []
        for ticket, assumed in self._tickets:
            if ticket.status in (OrderStatus.FILLED, OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID):
                self.shares += int(ticket.quantity_filled) - assumed
            else:
                pending.append((ticket, assumed))
        self._tickets = pending
        if self.shares < 0:
            self.shares = 0

        quantity = int(quantity)
        if quantity > 0:

    def liquidate(self, reason):
        if self.shares > 0:

        ticket = self._algorithm.market_order(
            self._symbol, quantity, tag="{0}: {1}".format(self._name, reason))
        if ticket is None or ticket.status == OrderStatus.INVALID:
            return
        self.shares += quantity
        self._tickets.append((ticket, quantity))

    * No trading until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed.

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    A_INVEST_PCT = 0.40         # invest 40% of total portfolio value

    # Strategy B parameters (slot 2, AAPL)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    B_ORDER_CASH = 20_000.0     # buy $20,000 if that much cash is available

    B_RSI_LEVEL = 60.0          # sell while RSI is above 60

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategies = {

    # ================================================================== #

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not self._RulesReady():
            return

        for name in self.slot_order:
            self._EvaluateSell(name, data)
        for name in self.slot_order:
            self._EvaluateBuy(name, data)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

            self.spy_close_cur = float(spy_bar.Close)

            self.spy_ma_prev = self.spy_ma_cur
            self.spy_ma_cur = float(self.spy_ma.Current.Value) if self.spy_ma.IsReady else None

                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:

            self.aapl_close_prev = close

        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if symbol not in data.Bars:
                return False
            bar = data.Bars[symbol]
            if bar is None or bar.Close <= 0:
                return False
        return True

        if not self.spy_ma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return False

        if None in (self.spy_close_prev, self.spy_close_cur,

            return False
        # Streak needs at least one prior close to have been observed.
        if self.aapl_close_prev is None:
            return False
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    @staticmethod
    def _CrossesAbove(x_prev, y_prev, x_cur, y_cur):
        if None in (x_prev, y_prev, x_cur, y_cur):
            return False
        return x_prev <= y_prev and x_cur > y_cur

    @staticmethod
    def _CrossesBelow(x_prev, y_prev, x_cur, y_cur):
        if None in (x_prev, y_prev, x_cur, y_cur):
            return False
        return x_prev >= y_prev and x_cur < y_cur

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Sell pass
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _EvaluateSell(self, name, data):
        state = self.strategies[name]

        # Sell reason is only evaluated while the lot is NON-empty,
        # and never while an order for that lot is still working.
        if state["shares"] <= 0 or state["pending"] != 0:
            return

        if name == "A":
            # SPY close crosses BELOW its moving average
            triggered = self._CrossesBelow(self.spy_close_prev, self.spy_ma_prev,
                                           self.spy_close_cur, self.spy_ma_cur)
        else:
            # AAPL 14-day RSI closes above 60 (level condition)
            triggered = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > self.B_RSI_LEVEL

        if not triggered:
            return

        # Sell details: liquidate this strategy's entire lot.
        self._Submit(name, -state["shares"], "sell")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Buy pass
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _EvaluateBuy(self, name, data):
        state = self.strategies[name]

        # Buy reason is only evaluated while the lot is EMPTY,
        # and never while an order for that lot is still working.
        if state["shares"] != 0 or state["pending"] != 0:
            return

        price = float(data.Bars[state["symbol"]].Close)
        if price <= 0:
            return

        if name == "A":
            # SPY close crosses ABOVE its moving average
            if not self._CrossesAbove(self.spy_close_prev, self.spy_ma_prev,
                                      self.spy_close_cur, self.spy_ma_cur):
                return
            # Buy details: invest 40% of total portfolio value.
            target_value = self.A_INVEST_PCT * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / price))
        else:
            # AAPL red for 3 (or more) consecutive days
            if self.aapl_red_streak < self.B_RED_DAYS:
                return
            # Buy details: $20,000 worth ONLY if at least $20,000 cash is available;
            # otherwise do nothing at all this bar (stay flat, may fire again later).
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) < self.B_ORDER_CASH:
                return
            quantity = int(math.floor(self.B_ORDER_CASH / price))

        if quantity < 1:
            return

        self._Submit(name, quantity, "buy")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Order plumbing: lots are tracked from actual fills
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _Submit(self, name, quantity, action):
        if quantity == 0:
            return
        state = self.strategies[name]
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(state["symbol"], quantity)
        if ticket is None:
            return
        self._orders[ticket.OrderId] = {"name": name, "remaining": quantity}
        state["pending"] += quantity
        if self.VERBOSE:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time.date()} slot{state['slot']}/{name} "
                       f"{action} {quantity} {state['symbol'].Value}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        record = self._orders.get(order_event.OrderId)
        if record is None:
            return

        state = self.strategies[record["name"]]

        fill_quantity = int(order_event.FillQuantity)
        if fill_quantity != 0:
            state["shares"] += fill_quantity
            state["pending"] -= fill_quantity
            record["remaining"] -= fill_quantity

        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Filled,
                                  OrderStatus.Canceled,
                                  OrderStatus.Invalid):
            # Release any quantity that will never fill.
            if record["remaining"] != 0:
                state["pending"] -= record["remaining"]
                record["remaining"] = 0
            del self._orders[order_event.OrderId]

            if state["shares"] < 0:      # defensive: a lot can never go short
                state["shares"] = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def OnEndOfAlgorithm(self):
        for name in self.slot_order:
            state = self.strategies[name]
            self.Log(f"Slot {state['slot']} / Strategy {name} "
                     f"({state['symbol'].Value}) final lot: {state['shares']} shares")
        self.Log(f"Final portfolio value: {self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue:,.2f}")

class StrategyLot:

class TwoSlotParallelSystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

            buy  : SPY close crosses above its moving average
                   -> invest 40% of total portfolio value in SPY
            sell : SPY close crosses below its moving average
                   -> liquidate Strategy A's entire lot

            buy  : AAPL red for 3 consecutive days

            sell : AAPL 14-day RSI closes above 60

        "crosses below"  : yesterday close >= MA AND today close < MA

      * Market state (streaks, indicators, previous closes) is updated
        continuously from data; only rule EVALUATION is skipped on days where
        some subscribed ticker has no bar.

    # so the standard 50-day simple moving average of the close is used.
    SMA_PERIOD = 50
    A_ALLOCATION = 0.40

    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0
    B_RED_DAYS = 3
    B_CASH_PER_TRADE = 20000.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Setup
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1000000)

        self._symbols = []
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY)
            self._symbols.append(equity.symbol)

        self._spy = self._symbols[0]
        self._aapl = self._symbols[1]

        # --- continuously maintained market state ---------------------
        self._prev_close = {}
        self._sma = SimpleMovingAverage("SPY_SMA_{0}".format(self.SMA_PERIOD), self.SMA_PERIOD)
        self._rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
            "AAPL_RSI_{0}".format(self.RSI_PERIOD), self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.WILDERS
        )
        self._red_streak = 0

        # --- private lots, in slot order ------------------------------
        self._lot_a = StrategyLot("Strategy A", self._spy, "STRAT_A")
        self._lot_b = StrategyLot("Strategy B", self._aapl, "STRAT_B")
        self._lots = [self._lot_a, self._lot_b]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        # arrived, independently of whether rules may be evaluated today.

        # is evaluated at all today.

        if not self._is_fully_formed(snapshot):
            return

        self._strategy_a_sell(snapshot)
        self._strategy_b_sell(snapshot)
        self._strategy_a_buy(snapshot)
        self._strategy_b_buy(snapshot)

    def _collect_bars(self, data):
        """Today's trade bars, keyed by symbol; missing tickers are simply absent."""
        bars = {}
        if data is None:
            return bars

        for symbol in self._symbols:
            bar = None
            if data.bars is not None and data.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                bar = data.bars[symbol]
            if bar is not None and bar.close is not None and bar.close > 0:
                bars[symbol] = bar

        return bars

    def _update_market_state(self, bars):
        """
        Advance every market-state quantity with today's data and return a
        snapshot holding both today's and yesterday's values.
        """
        snapshot = {}

        # --- SPY: close vs moving average --------------------------------
        if self._spy in bars:
            bar = bars[self._spy]
            close = float(bar.close)

            # Read the indicator BEFORE updating -> yesterday's SMA value.
            snapshot["spy_prev_sma"] = float(self._sma.current.value) if self._sma.is_ready else None
            self._sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

            snapshot["spy_prev_close"] = self._prev_close.get(self._spy)
            snapshot["spy_close"] = close
            snapshot["spy_sma"] = float(self._sma.current.value) if self._sma.is_ready else None

        # --- AAPL: consecutive red days + RSI -----------------------------
        if self._aapl in bars:
            bar = bars[self._aapl]
            close = float(bar.close)
            prev_close = self._prev_close.get(self._aapl)

            if prev_close is not None:
                # A red day: close strictly below the previous day's close.
                self._red_streak = self._red_streak + 1 if close < prev_close else 0

            self._rsi.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

            snapshot["aapl_close"] = close
            snapshot["aapl_red_streak"] = self._red_streak
            snapshot["aapl_rsi"] = float(self._rsi.current.value) if self._rsi.is_ready else None

        for symbol, bar in bars.items():
            self._prev_close[symbol] = float(bar.close)

            return False
        if snapshot.get("spy_prev_close") is None or snapshot.get("spy_prev_sma") is None:
            return False
        if snapshot.get("spy_sma") is None:
            return False
        if snapshot.get("aapl_prev_close") is None or snapshot.get("aapl_rsi") is None:
            return False
        return True

    def _crosses_above(prev_x, prev_y, x, y):
        """Yesterday X <= Y and today X > Y."""
        return prev_x <= prev_y and x > y

    def _crosses_below(prev_x, prev_y, x, y):
        """Yesterday X >= Y and today X < Y."""
        return prev_x >= prev_y and x < y

    def _strategy_a_sell(self, snapshot):

        if not lot.is_open or lot.is_busy:

        if self._crosses_below(snapshot["spy_prev_close"], snapshot["spy_prev_sma"],
                               snapshot["spy_close"], snapshot["spy_sma"]):
            self._liquidate_lot(lot, "sell: SPY close crossed below its {0}d SMA".format(self.SMA_PERIOD))

        lot = self._lot_a
        if lot.is_open or lot.is_busy:
            return

        if not self._crosses_above(snapshot["spy_prev_close"], snapshot["spy_prev_sma"],
                                   snapshot["spy_close"], snapshot["spy_sma"]):
            return

        price = snapshot["spy_close"]
        target_value = self.A_ALLOCATION * float(self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value)
        quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / price))
        if quantity > 0:
            self._submit(lot, quantity,
                         "buy: SPY close crossed above its {0}d SMA (40% of equity)".format(self.SMA_PERIOD))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _strategy_b_sell(self, snapshot):
        lot = self._lot_b
        if not lot.is_open or lot.is_busy:
            return

        # Level test: today's RSI value strictly above 60.
        if snapshot["aapl_rsi"] > self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self._liquidate_lot(lot, "sell: AAPL RSI({0}) closed above {1:.0f}".format(
                self.RSI_PERIOD, self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL))

    def _strategy_b_buy(self, snapshot):
        lot = self._lot_b
        if lot.is_open or lot.is_busy:
            return

        if snapshot["aapl_red_streak"] < self.B_RED_DAYS:
            return

        # Not enough cash -> do nothing this bar; the reason may fire again later.
        available_cash = float(self.portfolio.cash)
        if available_cash < self.B_CASH_PER_TRADE:
            return

        quantity = int(math.floor(self.B_CASH_PER_TRADE / snapshot["aapl_close"]))
        if quantity > 0:
            self._submit(lot, quantity,
                         "buy: AAPL red {0} consecutive days ($20,000)".format(self.B_RED_DAYS))

    # Order plumbing (lots are driven by actual fills)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _liquidate_lot(self, lot, reason):
        held = int(self.portfolio[lot.symbol].quantity)
        quantity = min(lot.shares, held) if held > 0 else lot.shares
        if quantity <= 0:
            lot.shares = 0
            return
        self._submit(lot, -quantity, reason)

    def _submit(self, lot, quantity, reason):
        quantity = int(quantity)
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        tag = "{0} | {1}".format(lot.tag_prefix, reason)
        ticket = self.market_order(lot.symbol, quantity, False, tag)
        if ticket is None:
            return

        # Backtest market orders can fill synchronously inside the call above,
        # in which case on_order_event has already run; only flag the lot as
        # busy when the order is genuinely still working.
        if ticket.status in (OrderStatus.NEW, OrderStatus.SUBMITTED,
                             OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
                             OrderStatus.UPDATE_SUBMITTED,
                             OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING):
            lot.pending_order_id = ticket.order_id
        else:
            lot.pending_order_id = None

    def on_order_event(self, order_event):
        lot = self._lot_for_order(order_event.order_id)
        if lot is None:
            return

        if order_event.fill_quantity != 0:
            lot.shares = max(0, lot.shares + int(order_event.fill_quantity))

        if order_event.status != OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED and \
                lot.pending_order_id == order_event.order_id:
            lot.pending_order_id = None

    def _lot_for_order(self, order_id):
        order = self.transactions.get_order_by_id(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return None
        tag = order.tag if order.tag is not None else ""
        for lot in self._lots:
            if tag.startswith(lot.tag_prefix):
                return lot
        return None

    def _reconcile_pending(self, lot):
        """Safety net: release the lot if its working order is already closed."""
        if lot.pending_order_id is None:
            return
        ticket = self.transactions.get_order_ticket(lot.pending_order_id)
        if ticket is None or ticket.status in (OrderStatus.FILLED,
                                               OrderStatus.CANCELED,
                                               OrderStatus.INVALID):
            lot.pending_order_id = None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def on_end_of_algorithm(self):
        for lot in self._lots:
            self.log("{0} final lot: {1} shares of {2}".format(lot.name, lot.shares, lot.symbol.value))

from AlgorithmImports import *

# An order ticket in one of these states will never fill again, so it can be
# dropped from a lot's working set once it is reconciled.
TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUS = (OrderStatus.FILLED, OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID)


class StrategyLot:
    """
    The private inventory of a single strategy.

    A lot only ever sells shares that it bought itself, so two strategies that
    happen to trade the same ticker can never touch each other's shares.
    """

    def __init__(self, algorithm, owner, symbol):
        self._algorithm = algorithm
        self._owner = owner
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.shares = 0
        self._tickets = []
        self._reconciled = {}

    @property

class StrategyLot:
    """
    A private lot of shares belonging to exactly one strategy slot.

    A slot only ever sells shares that it bought itself, so each strategy
    tracks its own share count independently of the shared portfolio holding.
    The lot counts as non-empty as soon as an order is in flight, which keeps
    a buy reason from firing twice before the first fill arrives.
    """

    def __init__(self, algorithm, symbol, name):
        self.algorithm = algorithm
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.name = name
        self.shares = 0
        self._tickets = []

    @property
    def has_pending_orders(self):
        self._tickets = [t for t in self._tickets
                         if t.status not in (OrderStatus.FILLED,
                                             OrderStatus.CANCELED,
                                             OrderStatus.INVALID)]
        return len(self._tickets) > 0

    @property
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.shares == 0 and not self.has_pending_orders

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0 and not self.has_pending_orders

    def buy(self, quantity, reason):
        quantity = int(quantity)
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        self._submit(quantity, reason)

    def liquidate(self, reason):
        if self.shares <= 0:
            return
        self._submit(-self.shares, reason)

    def _submit(self, signed_quantity, reason):
        ticket = self.algorithm.market_order(self.symbol, signed_quantity,
                                             tag=f"{self.name} | {reason}")
        self._tickets.append(ticket)
        self.algorithm.claim_order(ticket, self)

    def on_fill(self, fill_quantity):
        self.shares = max(0, self.shares + int(fill_quantity))


class TwoSlotParallelStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    One template, two slots, no gate; both slots run independently in parallel.

    Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy 40% of total portfolio value when SPY's
             close crosses above its moving average, liquidate the lot when it
             crosses below.
    Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy $20,000 of AAPL after three consecutive red
             days if that much cash is available, liquidate the lot when the
             14-day RSI closes above 60.
    """

    # Strategy A
    MA_PERIOD = 50                  # period of "its moving average"
    A_ALLOCATION = 0.40             # invest 40% of total portfolio value

    # Strategy B
    RED_DAY_STREAK = 3
    B_NOTIONAL = 20_000.0
    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = [self.add_equity(t, Resolution.DAILY).symbol for t in tickers]
        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        # Market state, maintained continuously from data on every bar.
        self.prev_close = {symbol: None for symbol in self.symbols}
        self.red_streak = {symbol: 0 for symbol in self.symbols}
        self.prev_ma = None

        self.spy_ma = self.sma(self.spy, self.MA_PERIOD, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, self.RSI_PERIOD,
                                 MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.lot_a = StrategyLot(self, self.spy, "Strategy A")
        self.lot_b = StrategyLot(self, self.aapl, "Strategy B")
        self._order_owners = {}

        self.set_warm_up(self.MA_PERIOD + 10, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, data):
        # Yesterday's values, captured before today's roll-forward.
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_close[self.spy]
        prev_spy_ma = self.prev_ma

        closes = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            bar = self._bar(data, symbol)
            if bar is None:
                continue
            closes[symbol] = bar.close
            previous = self.prev_close[symbol]
            if previous is not None:
                self.red_streak[symbol] = (self.red_streak[symbol] + 1
                                           if bar.close < previous else 0)

        if self._can_evaluate(closes, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_ma):
            self._evaluate_rules(closes, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_ma)

        # Roll state forward for the next bar.
        for symbol, close in closes.items():
            self.prev_close[symbol] = close
        if self.spy in closes:
            self.prev_ma = self.spy_ma.current.value if self.spy_ma.is_ready else None

    def _can_evaluate(self, closes, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_ma):
        if self.is_warming_up:
            return False
        if len(closes) != len(self.symbols):        # today's bar is missing somewhere
            return False
        if not (self.spy_ma.is_ready and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready):
            return False
        return prev_spy_close is not None and prev_spy_ma is not None

    def _evaluate_rules(self, closes, prev_spy_close, prev_spy_ma):
        spy_close = closes[self.spy]
        spy_ma = self.spy_ma.current.value
        crossed_above = prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_ma and spy_close > spy_ma
        crossed_below = prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_ma and spy_close < spy_ma
        rsi = self.aapl_rsi.current.value

        # --- sells, evaluated before any buy on this bar ---
        if self.lot_a.is_open and crossed_below:
            self.lot_a.liquidate("close crossed below MA")

        if self.lot_b.is_open and rsi > self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:
            self.lot_b.liquidate(f"RSI({self.RSI_PERIOD}) closed above {self.RSI_SELL_LEVEL:.0f}")

        # --- buys ---

class StrategyLot:
    """
    A private lot of shares belonging to exactly one strategy slot.

    A slot only ever sells shares that it bought itself, so each strategy
    tracks its own share count independently of the shared portfolio holding.
    The lot counts as non-empty as soon as an order is in flight, which keeps
    a buy reason from firing twice before the first fill arrives.
    """

    def __init__(self, algorithm, symbol, name):
        self.algorithm = algorithm
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.name = name
        self.shares = 0
        self._tickets = []

    @property
    def has_pending_orders(self):
        self._tickets = [t for t in self._tickets
                         if t.status not in (OrderStatus.FILLED,
                                             OrderStatus.CANCELED,
                                             OrderStatus.INVALID)]
        return len(self._tickets) > 0

    @property
    def is_empty(self):
        return self.shares == 0 and not self.has_pending_orders

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.shares > 0 and not self.has_pending_orders

    def buy(self, quantity, reason):
        quantity = int(quantity)
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        self._submit(quantity, reason)

    def liquidate(self, reason):
        if self.shares <= 0:
            return
        self._submit(-self.shares, reason)

    def _submit(self, signed_quantity, reason):
        ticket = self.algorithm.market_order(self.symbol, signed_quantity,
                                             tag=f"{self.name} | {reason}")
        self._tickets.append(ticket)
        self.algorithm.claim_order(ticket, self)

    def on_fill(self, fill_quantity):
        self.shares = max(0, self.shares + int(fill_quantity))

    Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy $20,000 of AAPL after three consecutive red
             days if that much cash is available, liquidate the lot when the
             14-day RSI closes above 60.
    """

    # Strategy A
    MA_PERIOD = 50                  # period of "its moving average"
    A_ALLOCATION = 0.40             # invest 40% of total portfolio value

    # Strategy B
    RED_DAY_STREAK = 3
    B_NOTIONAL = 20_000.0
    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    RSI_SELL_LEVEL = 60.0

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = [self.add_equity(t, Resolution.DAILY).symbol for t in tickers]
        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

                                  self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value / spy_close)

class StrategyLot:
    """
    A private lot of shares owned by a single strategy slot.

    Each strategy sells only the shares it bought, so position accounting is kept
    per-strategy instead of relying on the shared portfolio holding.
    """

    def __init__(self, name, symbol):
        self.name = name
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.shares = 0     # filled shares currently owned by this strategy
        self.pending = 0    # signed quantity submitted but not yet filled

    @property
    def IsEmpty(self):
        """A lot is empty (buy reason may be evaluated) only when flat and idle."""
        return self.shares == 0 and self.pending == 0

    @property
    def HasShares(self):
        """A lot is non-empty (sell reason may be evaluated) when it owns shares and has no order in flight."""
        return self.shares > 0 and self.pending == 0

    def Reset(self):
        self.shares = 0
        self.pending = 0

                 (liquidate the whole lot) when the 14-day RSI closes above 60.

    (streaks, indicator values) is always updated from each ticker's own data.

    AAPL_RSI_PERIOD = 14
